dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Sister is angry, so Arachatora is keeping a piece of "Head Mushroom," till the Sunsettia ripens ten times.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Keeping a piece?

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: #Cooking all the "Head Mushroom" for Nara {NICKNAME}, that was the plan. But sister said, no mushroom picking before the Sunsettia ripens another ten times.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Without the scent of mushrooms, Arachatora feels bad. Arachatora might sneak out for mushrooms when the Sunsettia ripens only nine times.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: So Arachatora kept a tiny little piece, thinner than the leaves. It will stay with Arachatora.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: So embarrassing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's a long wait...

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: *whimper*

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: But at that time, maybe "Head Mushroom" in Vana, could grow bigger, and have richer taste.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Perhaps... They'll grow into "Super Triple Head Mushroom."

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Thinking about that, makes Arachatora a little happier.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: *whimper*

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: At Festival Utsava, everyone is happy, Arachatora is even happier. When the Sunsettias ripen once more, I can go to find new mushrooms.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Once more?

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Yes! Arapacati said the "Head Mushroom" brought happiness to Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: That's why she's not angry anymore and I don't have to wait until the Sunsettias to ripen many times to pick mushrooms.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: I must find mushrooms with better flavors. I hope this time Arapacati won't be angry, or Arapacati will definitely have me wait until the Sunsettias have ripened 100 times, or even 100 times of 100 times.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: New mushrooms?

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: It's said that, somewhere far, far away, there are mushrooms that have the color of fallen leaves and grow on the feet of pine trees.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: There's another kind of mushrooms. They are as blue as the sky. They glitter at moonrise.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: That mushroom and the "Head Mushroom," which tastes better?

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: #For this "special cooking training," I want to find those mushrooms, and use them to cook the supreme delicacy for Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good luck!

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: #I will find mushrooms with richer flavors! Nara {NICKNAME} must come and enjoy the food together by then!
